name: guess-the-word
description: Guess the Word by Emoji - 50 question quiz, built with Remotion + GSAP easing math (Pattern 1: no GSAP timelines).

scripts.thumbs: remotion still src/index.ts ThumbZero out/thumbs/zero-wrong.png && remotion still src/index.ts ThumbLadder out/thumbs/46-of-46.png && remotion still src/index.ts ThumbEasy out/thumbs/too-easy.png
scripts.images:hd: node scripts/fetch-images.js --force && node scripts/resize-images.js && node scripts/refetch-broken.js
scripts.images:all: node scripts/fetch-images.js && node scripts/resize-images.js && node scripts/refetch-broken.js
scripts.pixel:render: node scripts/voiceover-scan.js && remotion render PixelGuess out/pixel-guess.mp4
scripts.pixel:draft: node scripts/voiceover-scan.js && remotion render PixelGuess out/pixel-guess-draft.mp4 --scale=0.5 --concurrency=4
